title: Add Two Numbers
description: Read two integers separated by space or newline and print their sum.
instructions: Parse both inputs as integers (not strings, so `3 + 5` gives `8`, not `35`).
Print only the resulting integer sum.
hints: Splitting stdin by whitespace (`.split()`) handles both space-separated and newline-separated numbers.
Convert tokens to integer before adding.

starterCode.python:
import sys
tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
a, b = int(tokens[0]), int(tokens[1])
# Print a + b
